reviews.title: Superb clarity and value
reviews.comment: I paired this monitor with a Mac and it provides superb screen clarity. Easily set up on my desktop; love the curve and the wide view for writing. The wide screen allows me to use the Mac function of having two different apps in side-by-side display for ease of accessing data from two different sources. Great value especially considering the price.

reviews.title: Not a curved monitor. Otherwise great!
reviews.comment: The size and resolution and picture quality are as specified. The monitor works great... However, I believe the description said its curved monitor. It's not a curved monitor. The back is curved (which made setup a bit trickier) but the front is just a flat monitor. I needed a monitor and the flatness didn't bother me so I kept it... But it really didn't match description

reviews.title: It works but get the extended warranty because who knows for how long it would work.
reviews.comment: So this gaming monitor is okay, it does has its bad. There was a small light sneaking out of the edge, I added pictures. The power supply gets hot like it is not enough to power the monitor, warm is good, hot is bad or going bad and cold its not getting any power. I am concern that the power supply will go bad sooner than later. There are some games that doesn't take freesync so there were some blinking. I thought it was the displayport cable so I got a 16k 60hz 80gps cable that should allow for high 170hz. Yes it goes as far as 170hz. There is no games I have that will ever go that high so I use it at 165 and as low as 120hz. Movies are bad on a gaming monitor with stuttering when camera moves but I can live with that. All in all, the monitor works and being that it is not a high end brand I also added 3 years of extended warranty, you should too. Updaye: Upon inspection, that light area that is showing it is from the screen separating from the frame. I still think it may not get worse and if I get a replacement, will it be worse or better? We will see. Update: I return the one I bought because the the screen coming off the frame and the replacement have the same but worse issue. I went to bestbuy and got a TCL 43 inch tv with 240hz motion for movies and 60hz VVR for games. I get great viewing on movies but a 60hz g-sync that is as smooth for gaming. I get both worlds for $149. Dollars and 25 dollars for 5 years warranty. Can't go wrong with that and it is branded not this product that seems that they sell the def3cted one in hope you stay with it., like second hand products. Don't buy!
